name: @epoch/performance-scale
description: W034 Performance + scale evidence suite: the instrumented compositions over the REAL measurement subjects (W036 solution-delivery, W039 actualization + variance, W026/W027 the two domain packs, W032 test-harness) — workload generators at declared ladder sizes against the typed budget catalog, complexity-class verification via measured count ratios, the regression gate (an inflated workload exceeds a budget -> the suite FAILS with the typed verdict, then restored), determinism (rerun = byte-identical counts/verdicts), negative (malformed workload, tampered digest, tenant isolation) and round-trip + digest verification for budgets, workloads, counts and verdicts. NOT a pnpm workspace importer: tests/performance sits outside the pnpm-workspace.yaml globs (owned surface, root manifests frozen), so this manifest DECLARES the frozen devDependency policy while import resolution happens via vitest resolve.alias + tsconfig paths. Run via: pnpm --filter @epoch/test-harness exec vitest run --root ../../tests/performance.
